tools.name: list_propositions
tools.description: List Decant's services with a one-line summary: lookups that run instantly, and requirements you can send.

tools.name: describe_proposition
tools.description: Everything about one service: what happens to a request, what you get, scope and limits, the request fields and any operations.

tools.name: submit_request
tools.description: Send a requirement to one of Decant's services. It is kept with a reference number.

tools.name: extract_web_page
tools.description: Read one public web page into title, headings, text, links and JSON-LD. robots.txt is honoured.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: extract_web_page · Public sink: list_propositions, submit_request · Destructive: list_propositions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: extract_web_page · Public sink: list_propositions, submit_request · Destructive: list_propositions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
